release_notes:
🚀 ReSeen v1.0.6 Background Update Engine, Strict Phantom Filter & Verified Personal Protection:
• Background Update Engine: Update downloads safely in the background even if dialog is minimized or back is pressed; automatically pops up Install prompt when completed
• Download Dialog Barrier Lock: Screen touches during active downloads no longer dismiss or cancel progress; barrier dismissible only before download starts
• Strict Phantom Status Filter: Completely blocks 'downloading documents', 'this photo was sent', and other progress messages from becoming chat cards
• Verified Personal Protection: Brand-new chats with fewer than 3 messages remain unverified and never receive a premature PERSONAL or SPAM tag
• Drawer Dynamic Installer: Updates drawer tile to 'Install Ready! 🚀' once background download completes for 1-tap installation
